validation_plan.telegram_health_validation: openclaw channels status must report Telegram enabled/configured/running/connected; no Telegram send/probe unless separately approved
validation_plan.m3_regression_plan: Verify no-send receipts, terminal closeout, production path unchanged, and all forbidden counters zero.
validation_plan.m4_regression_plan: Verify raw provider/model, missing VerifiedRoute, forged/deserialized route, and fallback without VerifiedRoute reject before execution.
validation_plan.m5_regression_plan: Verify valid manifest PASS, missing manifest HOLD, malformed manifest FAIL, unsupported capability HOLD, fallback preservation enforced.
validation_plan.m6_installed_runtime_validation_plan: Verify installed M6 contract-build lane artifact; valid M2 owner-turn intent builds lane; raw provider/model bypass fails; worker model is not route authority; contract envelope/no_send/terminal closeout preserved.
validation_plan.contract_build_lane_validation_plan: Verify token-broker-vmesh/contract-build route authority with worker model metadata only and no live provider call.
validation_plan.approval_boundary: No package install, Gateway restart, Telegram probe, provider/model live call, config mutation, authority/enforcement, or M7 without explicit staged-install approval.
